description: Versioned (mutation-class, channel) enforcement manifest for the guard enforcement matrix (Family B). Each row is enforced, waived:<id>, bypass, or n/a; an unwaivered bypass row is a named, recorded finding — never an unspoken gap. The probe fails closed when a hooks/scripts/guard_*.py has no row here (anti-staleness).

gate-reviewer Bash is held to a fail-closed allowlist: every simple command must be a listed read-only tool (cat, grep, rg, ls, find without -exec/-delete, jq, sha256sum, read-only git subcommands, ...) joined only by ; && || | or newlines; compound syntax, expansion, wrappers, unlisted programs, paths as programs and redirects other than /dev/null are denied — git can still run a program the repository's own git config names

no hook: Codex PreToolUse carries no agent_type.
